events.title: Update 0.8.9
events.summary: The Celestial realm has been buzzing with new players since the Steam demo launched, and from everyone on the team and the community, thank you so much for checking out the game!This update is the last planned before Nextfest, so we hope you enjoy what we've got!On October 31st, there's a tournament with prizes, as well as the conclusion of the Card Creation Contest, so don't miss out on those is you're competitive minded or a card designer:https://fateleague.com/tournaments/celestial-decks-octo

events.title: Season 5 Begins
events.summary: It's been two weeks since our Steam release, and it's been awesome to see so many new folks enjoying the game and hopping into matches! From our team, we're so glad you took the time to check out the game, and hope you'll stick around for more exciting journeys together!We'd be incredibly grateful if you could leave us a review with your thoughts. events.title: Season 3 Winner's Card Back
events.summary: The winner of last month's ranked season got the chance to design this new card back, which bears a striking resemblance to the man himself!Each player who won 10 PvP games last season has a redeemable copy, and the card back has entered rotation for packs and will be seen in the stores someday soon!Each card in a pack now has a 10% chance to be gold instead, which can be used to buy a collection of any card in the game.Pack mechanics have been more fully explained explained in more places.
